title: Yellow Garlicky Mediterranean Beans Skewers
description: A flavorful and energizing Mediterranean dish featuring refried beans, garlic, and vegetables, made Whole30-friendly by using agemono-deep-fry method, perfect for a quick lunch or snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together refried beans, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Thread cherry tomatoes, bell peppers, and onions onto skewers.
Brush the skewers with the bean mixture, making sure they are fully coated.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
